fusions.name: Eight-Armed Sip
fusions.desc: Looses 4 inky bolts at once, spread apart, each dealing 3 damage. 15% of the damage it deals comes back as healing over the following 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Squeezed Dry
fusions.desc: Wraps one enemy and squeezes, dealing 15 damage and consuming every affliction on it, adding 1.6 times their remaining damage to this blow. It only strikes a target at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Cloud of Ink
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 20 damage and holds for 6 seconds. For 4 seconds after using it, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Free Limb
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 5 damage. Once every 5 seconds.
